hero.headline: A Different Perspective.
hero.sub: Creating images. Transforming spaces. Telling stories.

intro.title: Image-making, with a feel for the spaces behind it.
intro.p1: I am an independent photographer and filmmaker based in Budapest, with around thirty years of experience behind the camera. I know how to light a room, frame a face and cut a film that holds together.
intro.p2: I also know what happens before the photograph: buying, renovating, furnishing and presenting a property. That is why I can help you prepare a space, not only record it.

items.title: Real Estate & Interior Transformation
items.short: Photography, film and styling that show a property at its best, before it goes on the market.

items.title: Portraits & People
items.short: Editorial, personal and professional portraits, photographed and filmed with care.

items.title: Business & Corporate
items.short: Portraits, teams, products and company films with a clear, polished look.

items.title: Hospitality & Gastronomy
items.short: Atmosphere, food and place for restaurants, bars, cafés and hotels.

approach.title: Before the camera comes out, the space is already working.

items.d: I start by understanding the place or the person: light, proportions, character, what deserves to be seen.
Small decisions change a picture: furniture, objects, colour, order. I can advise on all of them, or do the work myself.
Photography and film, carefully composed and lit, with the calm of someone who has done it for decades.
Edited, consistent images and films, ready for print, listings, websites and social media.

cta.title: Let’s create something exceptional.
cta.text: Tell me about your property, your portrait or your business. I reply personally.

services.title: Four areas, one eye for detail.
services.intro: Every project is quoted individually, according to your needs, location and timing. No packages, no surprises.

items.title: Real Estate & Interior Transformation
items.lead: I have bought, renovated, furnished, decorated and resold properties myself. I know what makes a space sell, rent or simply feel right, and I bring that eye to the photograph.
items.desc: From a light touch before a viewing to a full aesthetic transformation, I prepare the property first and photograph it afterwards. The result is images and films that do justice to the space.
benefits: A property prepared and presented to its full potential
Photography by someone who understands interiors
One contact for styling, photography and film
Practical advice on what is worth changing, and what is not
deliverables: Property preparation before sale or rental

items.title: Portraits & People
items.lead: Portraits that look like the person, in a light and setting that suit them. Calm sessions, clear direction, careful editing.
items.desc: For individuals, professionals, artists and models. Each session is designed around you: location, mood, wardrobe, and the use you have in mind.
benefits: A relaxed session led by an experienced photographer
Photo and video combined in a single session if you wish

items.title: Business & Corporate
items.lead: Clear, well-crafted visual content for companies that want to present themselves with confidence.
items.desc: I am developing this area and welcome first collaborations. I do not claim a corporate portfolio I do not yet have: you will get a direct, attentive professional and work you can judge from my existing portraits and interiors.
benefits: A single, direct point of contact
A visual style adapted to your brand
A small team assembled when the project requires it
Content ready for web, print and social media

items.title: Hospitality & Gastronomy
items.lead: Images that carry the atmosphere of a place: the light, the materials, the table and the people.
items.desc: Another area I am building. My experience with interiors and light translates naturally to restaurants, bars, cafés and hotels. Projects are discussed individually.
benefits: An eye for atmosphere and interiors
Photography and film from one person
Content for menus, websites, press and social media
Flexible, on-site shoots that respect your service

about.title: Direct, experienced, understated.
about.lead: I have been making photographs and films for around thirty years. Today I work independently from Budapest, for property owners, individuals and businesses.
about.p1: Over three decades I have learned the craft from the ground up: operating a camera, lighting a scene, composing an image, telling a story with pictures, and finishing it in editing and post-production.
about.p2: Alongside photography and film, I have worked hands-on with real estate: buying, renovating, furnishing, decorating and reselling properties. That experience changed how I photograph interiors. I see a room as both a place to live and a space to present.
about.p3: You deal with me directly, from the first conversation to delivery. When a project needs more hands, I bring in trusted assistants and collaborators.
